sights.w: Akron's first city-history museum, opened April 5 2025 for the bicentennial in a 1909 Main Street building: 60+ exhibits and 115 artifacts over three floors (Dr. Bob's AA office door, the Lighter-Than-Air Society's blimp relics), run by the Akron-Summit County Public Library with the Summit County Historical Society. Free.

258-acre Summit Metro Parks unit begun with a 1949 gift from Firestone Tire & Rubber: wetlands and marshy meadows along the Tuscarawas River and the old canal-feeder Tuscarawas Race, a sledding hill and 175+ recorded bird species.

Akron's jazz club, in a former shoebox warehouse beneath the Hermes building off Maiden Lane — a retro New York-style room with live music Wednesday-Saturday, a 'Black and BLU' menu and a jazz photography gallery. Covered by Cleveland Scene and Akron Life.

Single-screen 1938 neighborhood movie house anchoring Highland Square, with a full bar and cheap admission. On Cleveland Magazine's 12 must-visit Highland Square spots and a fixture of Signal Akron's Highland Square coverage.
